total_semantics.label: absent_in_most_captures
total_semantics.quote: 21/23 captured Cerner bundles omit Bundle.total entirely (no `total` key); the remaining 2 include a total that matches match_entry_count (e.g. immunization-12742399.json: total=24, matches=24).

token_stability.label: ttl_unknown_no_timestamp_in_token
token_stability.quote: Cerner next URL embeds an opaque pageContext (UUID/base64). No timestamp component, no documented TTL in measured fixtures.

total_semantics.label: reflects_page_size_when_count_set
total_semantics.quote: page_count_5: bundle_total=5 entry_count=5; page_count_1000: bundle_total=1000 entry_count=1000 — Bundle.total tracks the page payload, not the unbounded match set.

token_stability.label: stable_within_session_offline_observation
token_stability.quote: next_token_stable_across_pages: true (walked 2 pages; URLs did not duplicate or drift). TTL unmeasured offline.

total_semantics.label: reflects_returned_match_count
total_semantics.quote: All 15 captured bundles with a Bundle.total have total==match_entry_count (e.g. tests/golden/meditech/phase-b-2026-04-28/allergyintolerance-bundle.json: total=1, matches=1).

token_stability.label: ttl_unknown_continue_cursor_is_resource_typed
token_stability.quote: MEDITECH next URL uses `continue=<RESOURCETYPE-prefix>.<UUID>` (e.g. VS./LA./B76C...). No timestamp, no documented TTL.
